catalyst_text: Reported positive pivotal Phase 2 data at ASH
detailed_catalyst_text: Updated results from the pivotal Phase 2 iMMagine-1 study in relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma were presented at ASH. The dataset showed 96% ORR, 74% CR/sCR, high MRD negativity, and encouraging PFS/OS, with no delayed or non-ICANS neurotoxicities observed. These findings reinforce the therapy’s efficacy and safety profile in a heavily pretreated population.
catalyst_text_evidence: Arcellx, Inc. (NASDAQ:ACLX) ... today announced new positive data from its pivotal Phase 2 iMMagine-1 study of anitocabtagene autoleucel (anito-cel), in patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma (RRMM). These data are being presented during an oral presentation at the 67th American Society of Hematology (ASH) Annual Meeting and Exposition on 2025-12-06 at 2:45 p.m. ET. October 7, 2025, is the data cutoff date for this presentation and the BLA submission. Overall response rate (ORR) was 96% (112/117) with a complete response/stringent complete response (CR/sCR) rate of 74% (86/117) and a very good partial response or higher (≥VGPR) rate of 88% (103/117), per Independent Review Committee (IRC) assessment. To date, no delayed or non-ICANS neurotoxicities, including no Parkinsonism, no cranial nerve palsies, no Guillain-Barré syndrome, and no immune effector cell-associated enterocolitis have been observed with anito-cel with all patients dosed more than 12 months ago.
